command:
$content=@'
# UE development environment for the Linux OMEN node.
# Source this file:  . "$HOME/ue-dev-env.sh"
P="$HOME/.local/ue-bootstrap/prefix"
T="$HOME/.local/ue-toolchains/v26_clang-20.1.8-rockylinux8"
export UE_LOCAL_PREFIX="$P"
export PATH="$P/usr/bin:$PATH"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$P/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
export PYTHONPATH="$P/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages:$P/usr/lib/python3.10${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
export GCC_EXEC_PREFIX="$P/usr/lib/gcc/"
export CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH="$P/usr/include/c++/11:$P/usr/include/x86_64-linux-gnu/c++/11:$P/usr/include/x86_64-linux-gnu:$P/usr/include"
export LIBRARY_PATH="$P/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/11:$P/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu"
if [ -d "$T/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin" ]; then
  export UE_NATIVE_TOOLCHAIN="$T"
  export UE_CLANG="$T/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/clang"
  export UE_CLANGXX="$T/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/clang++"
  export PATH="$T/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin:$PATH"
fi
'@; $b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(($content -replace "`r`n","`n"))); $remote="printf '%s' '$b64' | base64 -d > /home/aatuska/ue-dev-env.sh; chmod 600 /home/aatuska/ue-dev-env.sh; sha256sum /home/aatuska/ue-dev-env.sh"; ssh -F NUL -4 -i "$env:USERPROFILE\.ssh\chatgpt-linux-aatuska-ed25519" -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o HostKeyAlias=192.168.0.128 aatuska@aatuska-OMEN-by-HP-Laptop-15-dc0xxx.local $remote
